# Scripts the Windows job on GitHub does not count against a push.
# One name a line, then a reason. ci-verdict.js fails the job for any failure
# NOT listed here, and says so when a listed one passes again, so this list can
# only shrink. Fix one, delete its line.

# What GitHub's hosted Windows machine cannot do. Run these on a real PC:
check:recorder     # the recorder refuses to start without a GPU's H.264 encoder, and the runner has no GPU
check:clips        # its first half records live, the same encoder
check:mainwindow   # keyboard focus and page timing on a desktop nobody is signed in to
